speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any specific triggers like sunlight or contact with certain materials? I also need to know if you have any personal history of autoimmune disorders like Lupus.

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any specific skin lesions, such as red papules, scaling, or blistering on your hands or feet, and are you experiencing muscle weakness or difficulty moving? Also, what specific materials or chemicals do you use while working on the rice farm and caring for livestock?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR). REQUEST IMAGES: Dermoscopy of hypopigmented macules and eyebrow thinning. Do you have any history of recent travel or contact with sandflies in your region?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pneumonia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis with associated peripheral neuropathy. The combination of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow/eyelash thinning, and pruritus in a patient with rice farm exposure strongly suggests Leishmania infection, while the earlier misdiagnosis of pneumonia is incorrect.
